title: Qwen CustomVoice model generates real speech
description: The Base Qwen checkpoint has no preset voices. Chelsie is invalid. Load mlx-community/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-CustomVoice-8bit and use an English speaker (Ryan). Prove generate() returns a real WAV, not a tone.
right_now_summary: Testing Qwen CustomVoice with Ryan to confirm generate() produces real speech WAV audio.
